registrations.proof: csoai/gspc-mcp listed; HTTP 200 2026-09-06. Its tools[] is exactly the seven free tools POST https://councilof.ai/mcp serves: board_totals, get_axis, get_card, get_root, list_cards, verify_card, verify_inclusion. Derived by comparing the Smithery detail endpoint with a live tools/list, not read off the page.
registrations.known_defect: A SECOND listing, csoai/gspc, is a stale duplicate and this row used to point at it. It names eight tools of which four do not exist on the server (measure, verify, jail-probe, enter-arena — tools/call answers -32601 for measure and jail-probe) and omits three that do (get_root, get_card, verify_inclusion). Its connection, https://gspc--csoai.run.tools, answers 401. Nothing in this repository produces either listing: there is no smithery.yaml here and no CSOAI-ORG/gspc repository, so both are dashboard-side records that only the account holder can change. The fix is to RETIRE csoai/gspc, not to edit a manifest — csoai/gspc-mcp is already correct. Owner ask; see OWNER-ASKS. Until then this row points at the correct listing and says the duplicate exists rather than quietly linking past it.

doctrine: Inside every AI. Every chat. Every marketplace.
manifest_rule: manifest is the CSOAI-side file a platform reads. It is null when no such file exists — it is never a URL we intend to create. On 2026-09-06 thirteen of these twenty-five named a councilof.ai path that 404s, two of them on live rows, so the field advertised thirteen doors that were not there. Nothing read the field, which is why it rotted unnoticed; scripts/outward-claims-guard.mjs now fails if a non-null manifest does not resolve. For the three MCP directory rows the served machine surface is POST https://councilof.ai/mcp, not a per-directory file.
status_rule: live = proof_url shows a CSOAI entry, verified at as_of. planned = no such proof is held. 'submitted' was retired 2026-09-05: it recorded an intention and read as a result, and 22 of 25 entries carried it with only the platform's homepage as their url.
